name: Nuhmudira's Mansion
title: Nuhmudira's Mansion
summary: A four-building mansion on a lawn between low hills: a 51 m clock tower, a 44 m main tower and two 38 m wings, with a silver fountain on the south side; the basement leads to Nuhmudira's Dungeon.

shots.standingOrder: Orbit Nuhmudira's Mansion clockwise at 78 m radius and 34 m height from south-south-east to south-south-west; never come closer than 55 m to any of its four buildings.
